correctness.rationale: For a uniform fair bridge of length 2n, Catalan primitive-excursion generating function E(z)=2zC(z) yields factorial moments E[(J)_r|K=k]=(n)_r(k−1)_r/(2n−k−1)_r (1≤k<n), uniquely determining Hypergeom(N=2n−k−1,M=k−1,sample=n); k=n is correctly treated as J=n. The exact return-count mass has Rayleigh scaling K/√n⇒X with density x/2 exp(−x²/4) and suitable Gaussian tails. The hypergeometric variance is k/4+O(1) for k~√n and a uniform conditional CLT gives (J−K/2)/n^(1/4)⇒√X Z/2; conditional variance decomposition yields √n(1−Corr(K,J))→√π/[2(4−π)]. Independently enumerated every balanced bridge n=2..7 and compared each conditional probability exactly. The proof of the limit is analytic and not established by these finite checks.
